title: Our Green Forest
text:
The forest is big and green. Many trees grow there. Birds sing in the morning. Animals live in the forest too, like foxes and deer.

People must protect the forest. When trees are cut down, animals lose their homes. Planting new trees helps the environment. Clean air and water are good for everyone.

questions.text: What do birds do in the morning?
What must people do for the forest?
What can we infer about animals when trees are cut down?
What is the main idea of the second paragraph?

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
to keep something safe from harm
places where animals or people live

paragraph_translations: A floresta é grande e verde. Muitas árvores crescem ali. Os pássaros cantam de manhã. Os animais também vivem na floresta, como as raposas e os veados.
As pessoas devem proteger a floresta. Quando as árvores são cortadas, os animais perdem suas casas. Plantar novas árvores ajuda o meio ambiente. Ar e água limpos são bons para todos.
